subject: Request: Dawn-shift SLA carveout, escalation ladder & runbook
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@mediapulse.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: support@mediapulse.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Dawn window coverage request (maintenance week)

Hi Alex,

We're starting a multi-day data migration next week that will likely increase alert volume during the 04:00-07:00 PDT window. Our SRE lead asked whether Redwood can approve a temporary SLA carveout or alternative escalation flow for that dawn window (Nov 23-26).

Specifically: can P2 responses be extended from 2 hours to 4 hours between 04:00–07:00 PDT, and can we use a reduced on-call roster (two responders instead of the usual three) for those mornings? Our team can accept a documented runbook + 30-min bridge requirement for P1.

Attached is our maintenance plan and expected alert profile. We appreciate any flexibility; this is a short, scheduled event and we want to avoid noisy, repeated wakes for both teams.

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Sr. SRE, Mediapulse
---
Attachments: mediapulse-maintenance-plan.pdf (summary, 3 pages)
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@mediapulse.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dawn window coverage request (maintenance week)

Thanks Jordan — and thanks for the maintenance plan.

Short answer: we can be flexible, but we need an internal approval path and an explicit escalation ladder/runbook from your side + a short rollback trigger if alerts spike unexpectedly. To move forward quickly, propose this approach:

- Temporary SLA amendment: P2 response window increased to 4 hours for 04:00–07:00 PDT on Nov 23–26 only.
- On-call coverage: Redwood will staff two responders dawn-shift (primary + secondary). Primary handles triage; secondary is on standby for escalation or handoff.
- P1s: continue to require 30-minute acknowledgement and immediate bridge activation — no change.
- Escalation ladder: Jordan (SRE lead) -> Mediapulse on-call -> Redwood primary -> Redwood secondary -> Redwood L2 (pager).

Two asks from our side before approval: 1) a one-page runbook with clear rollback threshold (error-rate or P1 count) and 2) confirmation that Mediapulse will monitor and proactively pause the migration if sustained P1s exceed threshold.

I'll loop in Marissa and Ben to confirm operational readiness and whether credits/contract amendment are needed.

Regards,
Alex Martinez
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@mediapulse.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dawn window coverage request (maintenance week)

Thanks Alex and Jordan — I reviewed the maintenance plan and the proposed carveout. From a CS/ops perspective I'm supportive with these clarifications:

- Timing: confirm exact days/times in ISO (Nov 23 04:00–07:00 PDT through Nov 26 04:00–07:00 PDT).
- Rollback trigger: propose either >5 P1s in a 60-minute sliding window OR sustained P2 backlog >20 for 3 hours. We prefer an objective metric.
- Credits: if we accept reduced roster and extended P2 window, we should offer a small service credit (one-off) as goodwill. Legal can draft a short amendment; I'll pull Finance in if needed.
- Communication: a 30-minute pre-window readiness check each morning where Mediapulse confirms monitoring status.

Ben: can your team run the reduced-roster shift? If yes, please attach the escalation ladder XLSX and I'll approve signoffs.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@mediapulse.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dawn window coverage request (maintenance week)

Marissa — we can staff the two-person dawn rota for the four days. Draft ladder attached and a short ops-runbook summary. Key points:

- Dawn rota: Primary (Ben) 03:45–08:30, Secondary (on-call pool) 03:45–08:30. We'll rotate daily to avoid fatigue.
- P1 handling: Primary acknowledges within 30m, starts bridge. Secondary joins if bridge not established within 12 mins.
- P2 handling in carveout window: triage starts, full RCA timeline preserved, but response window is 4 hours. If >3 P2s backlog in one hour, auto-escalate to L2 and reach out to Jordan.
- Contacts: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com, +1 415-555-0192), L2 pager group: l2-oncall@redwood.com.

Attaching: draft-escalation-ladder.xlsx, runbook-summary.md

Ben
Support Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
